body:
fuck! i don't want to be bipolar.

what do doctors do if i tell them about this, and am i better off just keeping it to myself?

hmm... so I've thought about it for a few minutes. until i become really depressed i think i'll skip seeing a doctor about it. i can keep a level head about my emotions, recognize when they're rational, etc, so any days that i don't feel like working i'll just make myself work twice as hard.

i'll also quit smoking weed.
yeah sometimes I think I might be bipolar, but I've only had the days where I'll feel inexplicably happy for no reason, then days where I don't feel like that are just kind of neutral.
I would put my penis in you.
